headline: Quiet day: EU leaders hold first AI summit in Dublin
body: A quiet Saturday. EU leaders held their first dedicated AI summit in Dublin, though it ended without formal conclusions, lifting Global Coordination by 0.14. Self-Destruction edged down and 1984 edged up. Horizon Balance edged up to -10.82 from -10.87.
movers_note: Self-Destruction -0.1, from the Dublin summit (-0.07) and fading earlier news (-0.04). Conquerors -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11). Descendants -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.11).
